description: C2 audit prerequisite: TranscriptHistory.capture/3 and prepare_capture/3 require message content; there is no public empty-transcript initializer. Widget init without prompt_context still requires an explicit authorized binding. Extend the existing TranscriptHistory owner and Conversations facade to ensure strategy targets/grants atomically without inserting a message, reusing Facts/Strategy, connector validation, transcript resolution and grant seeding. Define a focused internal initialization Action delegating to this owner only if required by the Action reuse gate; never expose it as an agent tool or accept arbitrary browser Facts. No new seeding subsystem: optional prompt_context continues through existing add_message persistence. Contract: verified Facts + provider/config/source provenance in; transcript IDs per actor/owner out, idempotent retry; reject missing/inactive Person, disabled/archived/mismatched config and invalid scope. Preserve revoked grants on reuse. Tests first: empty Direct initialized/readable, no Message or placement, repeated initialization same IDs, no regrant after revocation, denied foreign Person, malformed input, disabled connector rollback. Action assessment: reuse existing private ensure_transcript/seed_history_grants and canonical reader; extend storage API because capture would require a fabricated message. No new storage or public endpoint. Widget-specific ownership stays outside generic storage.
title: [830] Initialize empty authorized canonical history for widget binding
